# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub Issues.

Use
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/wxhcore/bumblehive/security/advisories/new)
to report them privately.

Include the affected version, impact, reproduction steps, and any suggested
mitigation when available. Remove API keys, tokens, session data, personal
information, and other secrets from logs or examples.

This policy covers the Python SDK, Server, WebUI, Desktop application, built-in
tools, skills, and MCP integrations maintained in this repository.
